The *Godhikattheragāthā* (Thag 1.51) is a verse text belonging to the *Theragāthā* in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. It preserves the verses associated with the elder Godhika. The text has been translated into multiple modern languages, with SuttaCentral recording nine translations across eight languages, including an English rendering by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels are cataloged on SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali tradition, however, DharmaNexus detects thirty matching passages distributed across three texts [DharmaNexus]. The text shares significant phrasing with the *Dhaniya Sutta* of the *Suttanipāta* (Snp 1.2), particularly between segments 1.3–1.4 and Snp 3.4–3.5, and is cited or commented upon in the *Suttanipāta-aṭṭhakathā* (segments 1.3–1.5) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus aligns parts of the text (segments 0.2–1.4) with another poem in the *Theragāthā*, the *Girimānandattheragāthā* (Thag 5.3) [DharmaNexus].
